architecture.dependencyLaw: Every production edge points to a lower layer or to a strictly earlier same-layer tier, and the complete graph is acyclic.
architecture.ownershipLaw: Every capability has exactly one semantic owner; package, product, target, module, file, test, resource, and declaration boundaries are chosen independently.
architecture.developerToolException: Institute governance and developer tooling may reside in swift-institute when their semantic owner is the control plane rather than a reusable four-layer library.

supersededAssumptions: The bundle inventories 464 repositories rather than the sealed 468-repository cutover population.
Its dependency graph has 478 planned nodes but only 133 edges derived from 21 sampled manifests; it is not a complete live graph.
Its direct swift-primitives-to-swift-atoms flag day was superseded by the completed staged cutover through swift-molecules.

preservedPrinciples: Placement follows semantic essence rather than current residence, size, dependency count, or naming suffix.
The original repository becomes the coherent primary successor and retains complete history; additional successors are additive.
Moved sources carry predecessor repository, path, blob, and commit provenance and are allocated exactly once with tests and resources.
Search the ecosystem for an existing owner before creating or moving a capability.
Use bounded package and consumer semantic verification rather than one aggregate ecosystem build or test.
Stop for principal direction only when no coherent successor can preserve an existing repository's semantics and identity.
